protocol.title: Single-Cell Chemoproteomics Identifies Metastatic Activity Signatures in Breast Cancer
protocol.platform: Single-Cell Activity-Dependent Proximity Ligation (scADPL) coupled to valve-based push-up PDMS microfluidic chip
cell_lines: Patient-Derived Organoids (PDOs) from TNBC primary and metastatic tumors, and ER+ pleural effusion/lymph node
protocol.objective: Automated microfluidic single-cell isolation and on-chip sADPL processing for multiplexed endogenous protein activity measurements at single-cell resolution; identification of a six-enzyme cancer-aggressiveness activity signature (Ag-6) correlated with metastatic breast cancer progression

device.configuration: push-up (fluidic layer thick, bonded on top of thin control layer, bonded to glass slide)
layers: Fluidic layer: ~72 g PDMS (10:1 base:curing agent); photoresist heights 18 mm AZ40XT (dome valve), 22 mm SU-8-3025, 70 mm SU-8-3025 (double-coated)
Control layer: 11 g PDMS (10:1); spun at 448g for 1 min; bonded to glass slide
Glass slide: 127.76 x 85.48 x 1 mm; bonded with air plasma 45 s at 800 mtorr
chamber_zones_per_assay_unit: II  - Single-cell trapping chamber (8 um constriction)
III - Cell lysis chamber (MCP lysis buffer + RPE spike-in)
IV  - Proximity barcoding element incubation (whole proteome; SA-oligo + ab-oligo)
V   - Proximity barcode ligation (splint oligo + Ampligase)

bonding.fluidic_to_control_layer: oxygen plasma 18 s at 860 mtorr (Harrick Plasma); incubated 80 C overnight
bonding.assembly_to_glass: air plasma 45 s at 800 mtorr; incubated 80 C overnight

CatBio.notes: Biotin-tagged; probe-protein complex detected via streptavidin-oligo conjugate in ADPL

FPBio.notes: Fluorophosphonate biotin; covalently labels active-site serine of hydrolases

JW480.selectivity: >90% NCEH1 signal inhibition; no significant effect on other Ag-6 targets
JW480.purpose: Confirm target specificity of NCEH1 scADPL signal (Fig. 1C, Fig. 2B)

StrepAvidin_OligoConjugate.role: Recognises biotin tag on probe-protein complex (one anchor of proximity ligation pair)

AntiBody_OligoConjugate.role: Target-specific recognition element (second anchor); six antibody-oligo conjugates in Ag-6 multiplex

SplintOligonucleotide.role: Bridges SA-oligo and ab-oligo when both are bound to the same probe-protein complex

LigationBuffer.composition: 0.05 U Ampligase, 0.3 mM NAD+, 10 mM DTT, 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.3, 50 mM KCl, 1.5 mM MgCl2

lysis_buffer.name: MCP lysis buffer
lysis_buffer.composition: 25 mM Tris pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM EGTA, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.5% sodium deoxycholate
lysis_buffer.notes: Selected after optimization against Pierce, CST, TM buffers (fig. S2)

spike_in_control.name: R-phycoerythrin (RPE)
spike_in_control.role: Inter-cell normalisation; added at lysis step; cells with RPE values >2 SD from mean excluded as outliers

preamplification.composition: 2.5x buffer, 100 nM primers, 200 uM dNTPs, 9 U Phusion high-fidelity DNA polymerase (NEB M0503L)

qpcr.master_mix: Luna Universal Probe qPCR Master Mix (NEB M3004E)
qpcr.normalisation: RPE spike-in control; values normalised to PBS (simple) or RPE (complex experiments)

ddpcr.notes: ddPCR showed lower SNR vs qPCR for NCEH1 (fig. S2); qPCR selected for all subsequent multiplexing

pdo_media.bc_pdo_media: BC PDO media (ref. 49: Sachs et al., Cell 2018)
pdo_media.dissociation: Dispase 37 C 20 min; TrypLE 37 C 5-10 min; 2% FBS stop; 40 mm cell strainer; centrifuge 450g 5 min
pdo_media.loading_suspension: 500 uL BC PDO media, kept on ice
pdo_media.conditioned_media_for_pdo: PBS + 2% FBS; anti-CD45-FITC staining 30 min on ice before loading

cell_prep_for_chip.pdo_immune_cell_filter: FITC-conjugated anti-CD45 antibody (30 min on ice); CD45+ cells excluded by on-chip FITC imaging

ag6_panel.description: Six-enzyme aggressiveness panel with established ties to cancer cell aggressiveness

phases.name: Single-plex validation: CTSL (ddPCR) and NCEH1 with JW480 inhibitor (qPCR)

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: 2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS to passivate PDMS surfaces and reduce non-specific cell adhesion

steps.name: Off-chip Cat-Bio probe labelling of SKOV3 cells
steps.notes: 5 uM Cat-Bio, 2 h (7200 s), 37 C in DMEM-F12 + 10% FBS; labels CTSL and CTSB

steps.name: Off-chip FP-Bio probe labelling of SKOV3 cells
steps.notes: 2 uM FP-Bio, 30 min (1800 s), 37 C; labels NCEH1, MGLL, FAAH, uPA

steps.name: On-chip single-cell trapping (Chamber II)
steps.notes: Cells resuspended to 50,000-100,000 cells/mL in PBS; one cell per assay chamber

steps.name: On-chip cell lysis (Chamber III)
steps.notes: RPE spike-in added at lysis; MCP buffer fills nanoliter chamber dead volume; volume minimised vs bulk sADPL

steps.name: On-chip proximity barcoding (Chamber IV)
steps.notes: SA-oligo and ab-oligo incubated 2 h at 25 C; concentrations mirror validated bulk sADPL window (ref. 36)

steps.name: On-chip proximity ligation (Chamber V)
steps.notes: Ampligase seals nick at 40 C for 45 min (2700 s); product = ligated barcoded amplicon

steps.name: Off-chip amplicon retrieval and preamplification
steps.operation: mix (abstracts 9 uL water flush + 18-cycle PCR off-chip)
steps.notes: Flushed with 9 uL water; preamplified in 11 uL (2.5x buffer, 100 nM primers, 200 uM dNTPs, 9 U Phusion); 18 cycles

steps.name: CTSL detection by ddPCR
steps.expected_result: 54-fold above vehicle-only control (Fig. 1B; n=2 biological replicates)

steps.name: NCEH1 inhibitor specificity QC: JW480 pre-treatment + FP-Bio + on-chip scADPL
steps.expected_result: >90% NCEH1 signal suppression vs uninhibited; no significant effect on other targets (Fig. 1C, 2B)
steps.notes: qPCR selected over ddPCR from this step forward: higher SNR, amenable to multiplexing (fig. S2)

phases.name: Multiplexed Ag-6 panel profiling in SKOV3 single cells

steps.name: Dual-probe pulse labelling (Cat-Bio + FP-Bio simultaneously)
steps.notes: FP-Bio (30 min) then Cat-Bio added for remaining 90 min; both probes present during final 30 min overlap

steps.name: On-chip single-cell scADPL: trap, lyse, barcode, ligate, preamplify
steps.notes: Six orthogonal Taqman barcode channels enable simultaneous qPCR quantification from same single-cell lysate

steps.name: Multiplexed six-channel qPCR quantification

phases.name: Heterogeneity profiling: HEK293T vs SKOV3; SKOV3 vs OVCAR3

steps.name: Dual-probe labelling of HEK293T and OVCAR3 cells
steps.operation: sequential mix-heat for each cell line

steps.name: On-chip scADPL for HEK293T and OVCAR3 (separate chip runs)
qPCR + fluorescence imaging readout; PCA dimensional reduction

expected_results.SKOV3_vs_HEK293T: All six Ag-6 targets significantly higher in SKOV3 (p <= 0.0001 to 0.03; Fig. 3A)
expected_results.SKOV3_vs_OVCAR3: Five of six targets significantly higher in SKOV3; NCEH1 highest change (Fig. 3B)
expected_results.PCA: SKOV3 vs OVCAR3 resolved at PC1 = 84.67%, PC2 = 8.37% (Fig. 3F)
expected_results.mRNA_vs_activity: FAAH and CTSB show discordant mRNA vs protein activity profiles (Fig. 3C)

steps.normalisation: Activity normalised to HEK293T (Fig. 3A) or OVCAR3 (Fig. 3B) as reference population; RPE internal control

phases.name: Patient-Derived Organoid (PDO) profiling: TNBC between-patient and ER+ within-patient

ER_plus_within_patient.notes: Left pleural effusion: early metastasis detection stage; greater intertarget heterogeneity and elevated CTSL. Right pleural effusion: later stage; general Ag-6 increase, decreased variability. Lymph node: general decrease in Ag-6 activity vs pleural effusions.

steps.name: PDO preparation and anti-CD45-FITC staining for immune cell exclusion
steps.notes: Anti-CD45-FITC staining 30 min on ice; CD45+ immune cells identified and excluded during on-chip brightfield + FITC imaging (fig. S6); PDOs dissociated via Dispase + TrypLE prior to loading

steps.name: Dual-probe labelling of PDO single-cell suspension
On-chip trapping with on-chip tumour cell imaging QC (FITC-negative gate)
steps.operation: mix then detect (fluorescence imaging to exclude CD45+)
steps.notes: Only CD45-FITC-negative (tumour) cells proceed to lysis and barcoding

steps.name: On-chip scADPL for PDO tumour single cells: lyse, barcode, ligate, preamplify
steps.normalisation: Normalised to RPE spike-in per cell; Z-scores calculated within each target relative to PDO1 (TNBC) or Lymph met (ER+)

steps.name: Ag-6 qPCR quantification on PDO single cells

expected_results.TNBC_PDOs: Higher Ag-6 in all metastatic vs primary tumor PDOs; highest in liver metastases (Fig. 4C)
expected_results.ER_plus_PDOs: Highest Ag-6 in pleural effusion cells; concordant with MDA-MB-231 (pleural-derived cell line) (Fig. 4D/E)
expected_results.general_trend: Ag-6 activity peaks during EMT / early metastasis; slightly decreases in established metastatic lesions (Fig. 4F)

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 16 basic blocks (BB1-BB16), 4 if/else gates, 20 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in minutes (m) or seconds (s); BioScript supports s and m only

duration_conversions.preamplification_18cycles: 18m   -> IR: 1080.0 SECOND (time abstraction; not cycle count)

compiler_observations.drain_vs_dispose_in_ir: BioScript compiler emits drain and dispose identically in IR (both resolve to sink); semantic difference exists only at physical execution layer
compiler_observations.preamplification_abstraction: 18m used to model 18-cycle PCR; IR emits 1080.0 SECOND; cycle count is not a supported BioScript operation
compiler_observations.single_cell_trap_abstraction: mix at 2s abstracts pressure-driven hydrodynamic single-cell capture (not DMF electrode mixing)
compiler_observations.unused_manifest: MCF7_Cells and MDA_MB_231_Cells declared in manifest for biological completeness; not dispensed in current .bs file (cell-line experiments encoded via SKOV3/OVCAR3/HEK293T/PDO branches)
